Run OG-specific association models with asreml
``` {r}
Run_MLMs_OrthoSpecific <- function(Kphylo, EnvTraitMatrix, motifMatList) {
  # Prepare log file
  logfile <- "/workdir/coh22/poaceae_tfbs/output/output_log.txt"
  if (file.exists(logfile)) file.remove(logfile)

  log_to_file <- function(msg) {
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    write(paste(timestamp, msg), file = logfile, append = TRUE)
  }

  # Load required packages once
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(asreml)
  asreml.options(verbose = FALSE)

  ePC_names <- colnames(EnvTraitMatrix)
  n_traits  <- length(ePC_names)
  nOrtho    <- length(motifMatList)

  # Set up parallel processing
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(1)
  doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)

  results <- foreach::foreach(
    i = seq_len(nOrtho),
    .combine       = 'c',
    .errorhandling = 'pass',
    .packages      = c('dplyr','data.table','asreml')
  ) %dopar% {
    ogID <- names(motifMatList)[i]
    log_to_file(paste("[OG]", ogID, "– starting"))

    motifMatrix <- motifMatList[[i]]
    if (is.null(motifMatrix)) {
      log_to_file(paste("[OG]", ogID, "– motif matrix is NULL, skipping."))
      return(list(list(
        ogID,
        NA_character_,
        NA_real_,
        rep(NA_real_, n_traits),
        rep(NA_real_, n_traits)
      )))
    }

    # Identify shared taxa 
    common_rows <- sort(Reduce(base::intersect, list(
      rownames(motifMatrix),
      rownames(Kphylo),
      rownames(EnvTraitMatrix)
    )))

    # Subset data
    Env_sub   <- EnvTraitMatrix[common_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    motif_sub <- motifMatrix[common_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    K_sub     <- Kphylo[common_rows, common_rows, drop = FALSE]

    # Build input data frame
    input_df <- cbind(as.data.frame(Env_sub), as.data.frame(motif_sub))
    input_df$assemblyIDs <- factor(common_rows)
    data.table::setnames(input_df, gsub("-", "_", names(input_df)))
    colnames(input_df)[seq_len(n_traits)] <- ePC_names

    # Iterate over motifs
    motifModels <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(motif_sub)), function(j) {
      motifID <- colnames(input_df)[n_traits + j]
      # skip if no variation
      if (length(unique(motif_sub[, j])) <= 1) {
        return(list(
          ogID,
          motifID,
          NA_real_,
          rep(NA_real_, n_traits),
          rep(NA_real_, n_traits)
        ))
      }

      # fit model within tryCatch
      tryCatch({
        form  <- as.formula(paste(motifID, "~", paste(ePC_names, collapse = " + ")))
        model <- asreml(
          fixed  = form,
          random = ~ vm(assemblyIDs, K_sub),
          ai.sing = TRUE,
          data   = input_df
        )
        summ  <- summary(model)
        wald  <- wald.asreml(model)
        phylo_var <- summ$varcomp$component[1]
        resid_var <- summ$varcomp$component[2]
        phylo_explained <- phylo_var / (phylo_var + resid_var)
        coeffs <- model$coefficients$fixed[2:(1 + n_traits)]
        pvals_log10 <- -(pchisq(wald[2:(1 + n_traits), 3], df = 1, log.p = TRUE, lower.tail = FALSE) / log(10))

        coeffs     <- if (length(coeffs) == n_traits) coeffs else rep(NA_real_, n_traits)
        pvals_log10 <- if (length(pvals_log10) == n_traits) pvals_log10 else rep(NA_real_, n_traits)

        list(ogID, motifID, phylo_explained, coeffs, pvals_log10)
      }, error = function(e) {
        log_to_file(paste("[Error] OG=", ogID, "motif=", motifID, "–", e$message))
        list(
          ogID,
          motifID,
          NA_real_,
          rep(NA_real_, n_traits),
          rep(NA_real_, n_traits)
        )
      })
    })

    # ensure return not empty
    if (length(motifModels) == 0) {
      motifModels <- list(list(
        ogID,
        NA_character_,
        NA_real_,
        rep(NA_real_, n_traits),
        rep(NA_real_, n_traits)
      ))
    }
    motifModels
  }

  parallel::stopCluster(cl)
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
# Identify models in which three or fewer taxa contain the motif (to filter out from results)
sparse_motifs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(mat.list), function(matrix_name) {
  mat     <- mat.list[[matrix_name]]
  n_taxa  <- nrow(mat)
  # number of taxa that have any non-zero value for each motif
  presence_counts <- colSums(mat > 0)
  # need at least 10 taxa with the motif, so anything seen in fewer than this is “sparse”
  min_obs <- 10
  low_cols <- which(presence_counts < min_obs)
  
  if (length(low_cols) > 0) {
    data.frame(
      OG     = matrix_name,
      motif  = colnames(mat)[low_cols],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}))
```

Run permulations on the top hits
``` {r}
top_model_list <- dplyr::filter(results_df, p.fdr < 0.01) %>%
  #dplyr::filter(OG == "OG0018131") %>%
  dplyr::select(c("OG", "motif", "ePC")) %>%
  split(seq(nrow(.))) # produces a list of rows

Run_Permulations <- function(top_model_list, EnvTraitMatrix, motifMatList, tree, n_perm) {
  # Load functions and packages once
  source(paste0(rootDir,"src/09_associationModeling/Permulate.R"))
  library(geiger)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(asreml)
  asreml.options(verbose = FALSE)

  # Set up logging
  logfile <- paste0(rootDir, "/output/perm_output_log.txt")
  if (file.exists(logfile)) file.remove(logfile)
  log_to_file <- function(msg, logfile) {
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    write(paste(timestamp, msg), file = logfile, append = TRUE)
  }
  
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(1)
  doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  results <- foreach::foreach(
    i = seq_along(top_model_list),
    .errorhandling = 'pass',
    .packages  = c('geiger', 'dplyr','data.table', 'ape', 'asreml'),
    .export    = c('phyloK','rootDir','permulate', 'run_model_asreml')
    ) %dopar% {
    ogID <- top_model_list[[i]][["OG"]]
    focal_motif <- top_model_list[[i]][["motif"]]
    focal_motif_cleaned <- gsub("-", ".", top_model_list[[i]][["motif"]])
    focal_envPC <- paste0("envPC_", top_model_list[[i]][["ePC"]])
    log_to_file(paste("Running permulations for", ogID, focal_motif, focal_envPC), logfile)
    
    motifVec <- motifMatList[[ogID]][,focal_motif]
    
    common_rows <- sort(Reduce(base::intersect, list(
      names(motifVec),
      rownames(EnvTraitMatrix)
    )))

    Env_sub   <- EnvTraitMatrix[common_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    motif_sub <- motifVec[common_rows]
    K_sub     <- phyloK[common_rows, common_rows, drop = FALSE]
    tree_sub <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, common_rows))
    tree_rooted <- midpoint.root(tree_sub)
    tree_rooted$edge.length[is.na(tree_rooted$edge.length)] = 0.1
    tree.rooted.resolved = ape::multi2di(tree_rooted)

    input_df <- data.frame(
      OG = ogID,
      assemblyID = factor(common_rows),
      motif = motif_sub,
      Env_sub
    )
    
    colnames(input_df)[3] <- focal_motif_cleaned

    tryCatch({
      permulate(input_df, focal_motif_cleaned, focal_envPC, tree.rooted.resolved, K_sub, n_perm)
    }, error = function(e) {
      log_to_file(e$message, logfile)
      NULL
    })
  }

  parallel::stopCluster(cl)
  return(results)
}
```

Function to make QQ plot 
```{r}
PlotQQ <- function(df) {
  # Create observed vs expected p values for plot
  observed_pvals = sort(df$log10pval, decreasing = T)
  observed_p.fdr = p.adjust(10^(-observed_pvals), method = "fdr")
  expected_pvals = qunif(seq(0, 1, length.out = length(observed_pvals) + 2), min = 0, max = 1)  ## Generate expected values. Note that we are using length+2
  expected_pvals = expected_pvals[expected_pvals != 0 & expected_pvals != 1]  ## Remove the two extra values since they are 0 and 1

  p_df = data.frame(observed = observed_pvals,
                    expected = -log10(expected_pvals),
                    color = ifelse(observed_p.fdr < 0.01, "goldenrod1", "#2C7BB6"))  # Assign color based on p.fdr
  
  ggplot(p_df, aes(x = expected, y = observed, color = color)) +
    geom_point(size = 7, alpha = 0.8) +  # Color determined by 'color' column
    scale_color_identity() +  # Use color values directly
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = '#D7191C', linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = 0.8) +  # Dashed red line
    labs(
      x = expression("-log"[10]~"Expected p-value"),
      y = expression("-log"[10]~"Observed p-value")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 36) +  # Minimal theme for clean appearance
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),  # Center and bold title
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),  # Bold axis titles
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = 'grey80'),  # Light gray grid lines
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()  # Remove minor grid lines
    )
}

PlotQQ_sampled <- function(results_df, frac = 0.01) {
  df_sampled <- results_df[sample(nrow(results_df), size = max(10000, round(nrow(results_df) * frac))), ]  # Keep max(10000 or frac)
  PlotQQ(df_sampled)
}

PlotQQ_sampled(results_df)
```

``` {r}
  geom_smooth(
    aes(x = as.numeric(motifCount), y = envPC_1, group = 1),
    method    = "lm",
    se        = TRUE,
    color     = "seagreen",
    linetype  = "dashed", 
    size      = 1
  ) +
  labs(x = "HSF/GARP Motif Count, OG0018131", y = "Environmental PC1") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 36)

# Taxa with more than 2 copies of the motif
top_taxa <- filter(all_rep_taxa, as.numeric(motifCount) > 0) %>% 
  left_join(metadata) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Species, assemblyID, envPC_1, motifCount))
```

```{r}
library(topGO)
mappingFile = read.table("/workdir/coh22/poaceae_tfbs/output/ogs/OGToZm_mapping_v2.txt") %>% # map to maize
   mutate(V1=sapply(V1, function(x) strsplit(x, "_")[[1]][1])) # For maize

all_ogs <- unique(mappingFile[mappingFile[,2]%in%names(mat.list),1])
top_ogs = unique(mappingFile[mappingFile[,2]%in%unique(top_hits$OG),1])

GODB <- readMappings("/workdir/coh22/poaceae_tfbs/output/go_enrichment/Zm00001eb.1.fulldata_goList.txt",IDsep = ",")
background = intersect(names(GODB),all_ogs)
tmp=factor(as.integer(background%in%top_ogs))
names(tmp)=background

# Define a function to process each ontology
algo <- "weight01" # Choose topGO algorithm
process_topGO <- function(ontology, allGenes, GODB, top_ogs, mappingFile) {
  tgd1 <- new("topGOdata", ontology = ontology, allGenes = allGenes, nodeSize = 5, annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = GODB)
  resTopGO <- runTest(tgd1, algorithm = algo, statistic = "Fisher")
  GO_res_table <- GenTable(tgd1, pval = resTopGO, orderBy = "pval", 
                           ranksOf = "pval", topNodes = length(resTopGO@score), numChar = 100)
  GO_res_table$sigGenes <- sapply(GO_res_table[, 1], function(x) {
    paste(mappingFile[mappingFile[, 1] %in% intersect(top_ogs, genesInTerm(tgd1, x)[[1]]), 2], collapse = ",")
  })
  GO_res_table_df <- as.data.frame(GO_res_table)
  
  # Filtering and transformation
  significant_results <- GO_res_table_df %>%
    #mutate(Fisher.FDR = p.adjust(as.numeric(pval), method = "fdr")) %>%
    mutate(pval = as.numeric(as.character(pval))) %>%   # make sure it’s numeric
    filter(pval < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(neglog10Fisher = -log10(as.numeric(pval))) %>%
    arrange(desc(neglog10Fisher))
  
  # Add ontology information
  significant_results <- significant_results %>%
    mutate(Ontology = ontology) %>%
    mutate(enrichment = Significant / Expected)
  
  return(significant_results)
}

# Process each ontology
significant_BP <- process_topGO("BP", tmp, GODB, top_ogs, mappingFile)
significant_MF <- process_topGO("MF", tmp, GODB, top_ogs, mappingFile)
significant_CC <- process_topGO("CC", tmp, GODB, top_ogs, mappingFile)

# Merge results
merged_results <- bind_rows(significant_BP, significant_MF, significant_CC) %>%
  arrange(desc(neglog10Fisher))

#View(merged_results_most_conserved[,c(2,4,5,8,9)])
View(merged_results[,c(2,3,4,5,6,8,10)])
top_terms <- merged_results[1:7,]
#top_terms <- significant_MF[1:6,]
top_terms$Term <- sapply(top_terms$Term, function(x) substr(x, 1, 30)) # Truncate terms to make plotting prettier
# bubble plot
ggplot(top_terms, aes(
  x = neglog10Fisher, 
  y = reorder(Term, neglog10Fisher), 
  size = Significant, 
  color = enrichment
)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1.5, 3)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", limits = c(1, 12)) +
  scale_size(range = c(10, 40)) +  # This line affects bubble size
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Fisher)", 
    y = NULL, # Remove axis title for y to match your example
    size = "Significant",
    color = "Enrichment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), # Adjust text size for better visibility
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "grey80"), # Add gridlines for alignment
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14))

write.csv(merged_results[,c(2,3,4,5,6,8,10)], "/workdir/coh22/poaceae_tfbs/results/models/GO_topAssociationModelHits.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
